note: the global angle is ignored and every effect uses its own light angle, caught by PSDEffectsTests.usesGlobalLight
an effect's Opct is read as 0...1 instead of percent, caught by PSDEffectsTests.opacityIsPercent
a second instance of one effect is kept as well as noted, caught by PSDEffectsTests.multiNoted
anchor: guard index == 0 else { map.note("\(names[base] ?? base) \(index + 1)"); continue }

note: every effect reads Clr before its case, so a gradient overlay or bevel without one is dropped, caught by PSDEffectsTests.gradientOverlayNeedsNoColourKey
an out-of-range effect number is passed through unclamped, caught by PSDEffectsClampTests.outOfRangeValuesClampWithANoteAndKeepTheEffect
a clamped effect number adds no clamp note, caught by PSDEffectsClampTests.outOfRangeValuesClampWithANoteAndKeepTheEffect
anchor: if d[key] != nil, read != value { clamped(field) }
replacement: if d[key] == nil, read != value { clamped(field) }

note: an angle past 360 is not wrapped, caught by PSDEffectsClampTests.outOfRangeValuesClampWithANoteAndKeepTheEffect
a bevel's texture is dropped without a note, caught by PSDEffectsClampTests.bevelGlossContourContourAndTextureAreNoted
a bevel's gloss contour is dropped without a note, caught by PSDEffectsClampTests.bevelGlossContourContourAndTextureAreNoted
anchor: if (d.object("TrnS")?.list("Crv ")?.count ?? 0) > 2 { note("bevel and emboss gloss contour") }
replacement: if (d.object("TrnS")?.list("Crv ")?.count ?? 0) > 3 { note("bevel and emboss gloss contour") }

note: a bevel's angle keeps the file's counterclockwise sign, caught by PSDEffectsClampTests.bevelAngleTurnsClockwiseAndUsesTheGlobalAltitude
a bevel using the global light ignores the global altitude, caught by PSDEffectsClampTests.bevelAngleTurnsClockwiseAndUsesTheGlobalAltitude
anchor: guard d.bool("uglg") == true, let global = light.altitude else
replacement: guard d.bool("uglg") == false, let global = light.altitude else

note: an unmappable effect notes a doubled suffix, caught by PSDEffectsClampTests.anUnmappableEffectNotesOnceUnreadable
